1.word_for_word: सप्त-विंशे तद् आलक्ष्य कृष्णस्य प्राभवं परम् । — In the twenty-seventh century, Lord Kṛṣṇa noticed His transcendental power.; वर्ण्यते सुरभीन्द्राभ्याम् अभिषेक-महोत्सवः ॥ — The great festivities of the coronation of the two kings are described.; गोवर्धने धृते शैल इति शक्रस्य भयेन आगमने हेतुः, आसाराद् रक्षिते व्रज इति सुरभेर् हर्षेणागमने ॥१॥ — The reason for Indra's arrival in fear was that the mountain was held in Govardhana and the joyful arrival of Surabhi was that Vraja was protected from Asara.
1.translation: In the twenty-seventh century, Lord Kṛṣṇa noticed His transcendental power. The great festivities of the coronation of the two kings are described. The reason for Indra's arrival in fear was that the mountain was held in Govardhana and the joyful arrival of Surabhi was that Vraja was protected from Asara.

2.word_for_word: तत्रेन्द्र आगत्य किं कृतवांस् तद् आह---विविक्त उपसङ्गम्येत्य्-आदिना अथाह सुरभिर् इत्य् अतः प्राक्तनेन ग्रन्थेन । — When Indra came there, he asked him what he had done.; विविक्ते एकान्ते । — In a secluded solitude.; पादयोः पस्पर्श नमश् चकार ॥२॥ — He touched her feet and bowed down.
2.translation: When Indra came there, he asked him what he had done. In a secluded solitude. He touched her feet and bowed down.

3.word_for_word: अस्य श्री-कृष्णस्य श्रुतश् चासाव् अनुभावश् च श्रुतानुभावः दृष्टः श्रुतानुभावो येन स इन्द्रः । — He who has heard and seen the power of this Lord Krishna is Indra.; नष्टस् त्रि-लोकेशोऽहम् इति मदो यस्य सः ॥३॥ — He whose pride is lost in thinking that he is the lord of the three worlds.
3.translation: He who has heard and seen the power of this Lord Krishna is Indra. He whose pride is lost in thinking that he is the lord of the three worlds.

4.word_for_word: तत्र ममापराधं क्षमस्वेति वक्तुं तव तावद् अपराधो नस्त्य् एव त्वयानुग्रह एव कृत इत्य् आह चतुर्भिः---विशुद्ध-सत्त्वम् इति । — There, to say, “Forgive me my fault,” he replied, “You have no fault so much as you have shown me mercy.” The four replied, “You are pure being.”; धाम स्वरूपं । — The form of the abode.; शान्तम् एक-रूपम्, अतश् च तपो-मयं प्रचुर-ज्ञानं सर्वज्ञम् इत्य् अर्थः । — It means that He is peaceful, one-form, and therefore omniscient, full of austerities and abundant knowledge.; कुतः ? — Where is it from?; ध्वस्त-रजस्-तमस्कं ध्वस्ते अविद्यमाने रजस्-तमसी यस्मिन् । — The destroyed Rajas and Tamas are destroyed when the Rajas and Tamas are not present.; अत एवायम् अस्मद्-आदिषु दृश्यमानो माया-कार्य-रूपो गुण-संप्रवाहः गुणैः संप्रोह्यत इति तथा, संसार इत्य् अर्थः । — That is why this same flow of qualities in the form of illusory works seen in us and others is permeated by the qualities, and thus, it means the world.; स ते तव न विद्यते । — That doesn’t exist for you.; यतः अग्रहणेन अज्ञानेन अनुबध्यत इति तथा, स सर्वज्ञस्य ते नास्तीत्य् अर्थः । — Because it is bound by ignorance by non-perception, it means that the omniscient does not exist in you.; अज्ञान-सम्बन्धो वा ॥४॥ — or the relationship of ignorance.
4.translation: There, to say, “Forgive me my fault,” he replied, “You have no fault so much as you have shown me mercy.” The four replied, “You are pure being.” The form of the abode. It means that He is peaceful, one-form, and therefore omniscient, full of austerities and abundant knowledge. Where is it from? The destroyed Rajas and Tamas are destroyed when the Rajas and Tamas are not present. That is why this same flow of qualities in the form of illusory works seen in us and others is permeated by the qualities, and thus, it means the world. That doesn’t exist for you. Because it is bound by ignorance by non-perception, it means that the omniscient does not exist in you. or the relationship of ignorance.

5.word_for_word: यदा अज्ञान-तत्-कृत-देह-सम्बन्धौ न स्तस् तदा तत् कृतानां लोभादीनां का वार्तेत्य् आह---कुतो नु इति । — When there is no relationship between ignorance and the body created by it, then what is the point of greed and other things created by it?; तत् कृता देह-सम्बन्ध-कृताः तद्-धेतवः पुनर् अन्यस्य देहस्य हेतवः । — The causes of that body are the causes of another body.; ननु ज्ञानिनाम् अपि ते दृश्यन्तेऽत आह---अबुध-लिङ्ग-भावा अज्ञानिनां गमकाः । — Indeed, they are seen even by the wise.; यावद् रागादि-मत्त्वं तावज् ज्ञानित्वम् एव न सिद्धम् इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that as long as there is the essence of passion and other things, knowledge itself is not perfect.; लोभाद्य्-अभावेऽपि मन्-मान-भङ्गो दण्डार्थम् इत्य् आह---तथापीति ॥५॥ — Even in the absence of greed and other factors, the violation of self-respect is for the purpose of punishment, he argues.
5.translation: When there is no relationship between ignorance and the body created by it, then what is the point of greed and other things created by it? The causes of that body are the causes of another body. Indeed, they are seen even by the wise. This means that as long as there is the essence of passion and other things, knowledge itself is not perfect. Even in the absence of greed and other factors, the violation of self-respect is for the purpose of punishment, he argues.

6.word_for_word: ननु त्वद्-दण्डे च मम गोप-पुत्रस्य का शक्तिः । — Indeed, what power do I, the son of a cowherd boy, have in your punishment?; किं वा, कारणं, को वा दण्डो मया कृत इत्य् अत आह---पितेति । — What, the reason, and what punishment I have inflicted?; त्वं पिता जगतां जनकः, गुरूपदेष्टा, अधीशो नियन्ता, इति दण्ड-धारणे हेतु-त्रयम् । — You are the father, the father of the worlds, the teacher, the teacher, the master and the controller, and there are three reasons for holding the rod.; कालत्वात् समर्थः, तस्माद् उपात्त-दण्डो हिताय कल्याणाय स्वेच्छा-तनुभिर् लीलावतारैः समीहसे । — Because you are capable of time, you are able to carry out the punishment you have received for the good and welfare of others.; तव समीहा लीलैव जगद्-ईश-मानिनाम् अस्माकं मान-विधूननम् इत्य् अर्थः ॥६॥ — This means that Your pastimes are the destruction of our pride by those who consider themselves to be the Lord of the universe.
6.translation: Indeed, what power do I, the son of a cowherd boy, have in your punishment? What, the reason, and what punishment I have inflicted? You are the father, the father of the worlds, the teacher, the teacher, the master and the controller, and there are three reasons for holding the rod. Because you are capable of time, you are able to carry out the punishment you have received for the good and welfare of others. This means that Your pastimes are the destruction of our pride by those who consider themselves to be the Lord of the universe.

7.word_for_word: कथम् एतद् ? — How is this ?; इत्य् अत आह---य इति । — It is therefore argued that it is.; मद्-विधाश् च ते अज्ञाश् च ते, अतो जगद्-ईश-मानिनः काले भय-कालेऽपि यथाधुनैवातिवृष्टौ त्वाम् अभयं भयम् अगणयन्तं वीक्ष्य आशु तन्-मदं जगद्-ईशा इति मदं हित्वा विगत-गर्वाः सन्तः आर्य-मार्गं त्वद्-भक्ति-लक्षणं भजन्ति । — They are like me and they are ignorant, so those who think they are the Lord of the universe, even in times of fear, as they are now in the heavy rain, quickly abandon their pride in being the Lord of the universe and follow the noble path characterized by devotion to You.; अतस् तव ईहा एव स्वकानाम् अनुशासनं दण्ड इत्य् अर्थः ॥७॥ — Therefore, this is your world, the discipline and punishment of your own, that is, the punishment.
7.translation: How is this ? It is therefore argued that it is. They are like me and they are ignorant, so those who think they are the Lord of the universe, even in times of fear, as they are now in the heavy rain, quickly abandon their pride in being the Lord of the universe and follow the noble path characterized by devotion to You. Therefore, this is your world, the discipline and punishment of your own, that is, the punishment.

8.word_for_word: एवं भगवत्-स्वरूपम् अभिप्रायं चानुवर्ण्य क्षमापयति---स त्वम् इति । — Thus, describing the nature and intention of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, he forgives Him by saying, “That is You.”; एवं-भूता असती मतिर् मे पुनर् मा भूद् इति प्रार्थनान्तरम् ॥८॥ — After praying, "Let not my mind thus become untrue again.
8.translation: Thus, describing the nature and intention of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, he forgives Him by saying, “That is You.” After praying, "Let not my mind thus become untrue again.

9.word_for_word: महान् अयम् अपराधः कथं क्षन्तव्यः ? — How can this great crime be forgiven?; इति चेद्, अत आह---तव इति । — If so, then he argues that it is yours.; स्वयं भराणां पुनश् च उरु-भार-जन्मनां बहूनां भाराणां जन्म येभ्यस् तेषाम् अभवाय नाशाय, युष्मच्-चरण-सेविनां तु भवाय । — The burdens themselves, and again the burdens of the thighs, are born of many burdens, for the destruction of those from whom they are born, and for the prosperity of those who serve Your feet.; अतो मम त्वत्-सेवकत्वाद् अत्यन्तापराधिनोऽपि क्षन्तव्यम् इति भावः ॥९॥ — Therefore, as Your servant, I should be forgiven even the most offender, this means.
9.translation: How can this great crime be forgiven? If so, then he argues that it is yours. The burdens themselves, and again the burdens of the thighs, are born of many burdens, for the destruction of those from whom they are born, and for the prosperity of those who serve Your feet. Therefore, as Your servant, I should be forgiven even the most offender, this means.

10.word_for_word: क्षमापयन् नमस्करोति---नम इति । — He forgives and bows down.; तुभ्यं भगवते कृष्णाय नमः । — I offer my obeisances to you, Lord Krishna.; पुरुषाय सर्वान्तर्यामिणे । — To the Supreme Being, the all-pervading One.; महात्मनेऽन्तः-स्थत्वेऽप्य् अपरिच्छिन्नाय । — Even though He is within the great Self, He is not separated from Him.; कुतः ? — Where is it from?; वासुदेवाय सर्व-निवासाय । — O Vasudeva, you are the abode of all.; सात्वतां यादवानां पतये ॥१०॥ — O lord of the Satvatas and the Yadavas.
10.translation: He forgives and bows down. I offer my obeisances to you, Lord Krishna. To the Supreme Being, the all-pervading One. Even though He is within the great Self, He is not separated from Him. Where is it from? O Vasudeva, you are the abode of all. O lord of the Satvatas and the Yadavas.

11.word_for_word: तर्हि किम् अहं यादवः ? — So am I a Yadava?; न, स्वच्छन्दोपात्त-देहाय स्वेषां भक्तानां छन्देनेच्छया स्वीकृत-देहाय । — No, for the body assumed by His own will, the body accepted by His devotees at His own will.; तत्रापि विशुद्धं ज्ञानम् एव मूर्तिर् यस्य, तस्मै । — Even there, pure knowledge is the idol of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.; मायया सर्वस्मै सर्व-रूपाय । — By illusion, to all in all forms.; कुतः ? — Where is it from?; सर्वस्य बीजाय कारणाय । — For the seed and cause of everything.; अत एव सर्व-भूतात्मने नम इति ॥११.१७॥ — That is why I offer my obeisances to the Soul of all beings.
11.translation: So am I a Yadava? No, for the body assumed by His own will, the body accepted by His devotees at His own will. Even there, pure knowledge is the idol of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. By illusion, to all in all forms. Where is it from? For the seed and cause of everything. That is why I offer my obeisances to the Soul of all beings.

12.word_for_word: कृतागस इत्य् अनेनोक्तम् अपराधं निवेदयति---मयेदम् इति । — He reports the offense he has committed, saying, “I have done this.”; आसार-वायुभिर् गोष्ठ-नाशाय मयेदम् अकृत्यं चेष्टितं कृतम् ॥१२॥ — I have committed this improper act to destroy the cowshed with the winds of Asara.
12.translation: He reports the offense he has committed, saying, “I have done this.” I have committed this improper act to destroy the cowshed with the winds of Asara.

13.word_for_word: तथापि भो ईश, त्वयानुगृहीतोऽस्मि । — Yet, O Lord, You have been gracious to me.; अनुग्रहं दर्शयति, ध्वस्त-स्तम्भ इति, वृथोद्यम इति च । — It shows grace, that it is a destroyed pillar, and that it is a vain endeavor.
13.translation: Yet, O Lord, You have been gracious to me. It shows grace, that it is a destroyed pillar, and that it is a vain endeavor.

14.word_for_word: इन्द्रेण स्वाभिप्राये निवेदिते भगवान् अपि तथैवाह---मयेति, इन्द्र-श्रिया देव-राज्येन ॥१४॥ — When Indra informed him of his intention the Supreme Personality of Godhead replied in the same manner: "By me, by the opulence of Indra and by the kingdom of the gods.
14.translation: When Indra informed him of his intention the Supreme Personality of Godhead replied in the same manner: "By me, by the opulence of Indra and by the kingdom of the gods.

15-16.word_for_word: इन्द्रेण स्वाभिप्राये निवेदिते भगवान् अपि तथैवाह । — When Indra explained his intention, the Supreme Personality of Godhead replied in the same way.; इन्द्र-श्रिया देव-राज्येन ॥१५.१६॥ — Indra-sriya and the kingdom of the gods.
15-16.translation: When Indra explained his intention, the Supreme Personality of Godhead replied in the same way. Indra-sriya and the kingdom of the gods.

17.word_for_word: वो युष्माभिः । — Wo you guys.; बहु-वचनं वरुणाद्य्-अभिप्रायेण । — The plural means Varuna and others.; क्व गन्तव्यं स्वर्गेऽपि तवैवेश्वरत्वाद् इति चेत् तत्राह---क्रियताम् इति । — If we ask where to go, even in heaven, since you are the Lord, he says, “Do it.”; मद्-अनुशासनेन यथा-पूर्वं तत्र स्थीयताम् इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that you should stay there as before under My discipline.; युक्तैर् अप्रमत्तैः । — by the righteous and the careless.; स्तम्भ-वर्जितैर् निरहङ्कारैः ॥१७॥ — devoid of pillars and without ego.
17.translation: Wo you guys. The plural means Varuna and others. If we ask where to go, even in heaven, since you are the Lord, he says, “Do it.” This means that you should stay there as before under My discipline. by the righteous and the careless. devoid of pillars and without ego.

18.word_for_word: स्व-सन्तानैर् गोभिः सहोपामन्त्र्य कृष्ण-कृष्णेत्य्-आदि-सम्बोध्य । — He invited his children and cows together and addressed them as Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa.
18.translation: He invited his children and cows together and addressed them as Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa.

19.word_for_word: इन्द्रेण हता अपि भवता सनाथा वयं कृताः । — Even though we were killed by Indra, you have made us your masters.; रक्षिता इत्य् अर्थः ॥१९॥ — protected, i.e., protected.
19.translation: Even though we were killed by Indra, you have made us your masters. protected, i.e., protected.

20.word_for_word: त्वं नः परमं दैवं देवता । — You are our supreme destiny, the goddess.; अतो हे जगत्-पते ! — Therefore, O Lord of the universe!; गो-विप्र-देवानां येऽन्ये च साधवः, तेषां भवायाभ्युदयायाद्य त्वम् एव नोऽस्माकम् इन्द्रो भव ॥२०॥ — For the welfare of cows, brāhmaṇas, gods and all other saintly persons, now become Thou our Indra.
20.translation: You are our supreme destiny, the goddess. Therefore, O Lord of the universe! For the welfare of cows, brāhmaṇas, gods and all other saintly persons, now become Thou our Indra.

21.word_for_word: ननु भवताम् इन्द्रोऽस्तीति चेद् अत आह---इन्द्रम् इति । — If, indeed, you have Indra, then he argues that it is Indra.; अलं पुरन्दरस्येन्द्रतयेत्य् अर्थः । — This means that it is enough for Purandara to become Indra.; ननु देव एवेन्द्रो भवति, कथम् अहं भवेयम् इति चेद् अत आह---अवतीर्णोऽसीति ॥२१॥ — If, indeed, the god himself becomes Indra, how can I become? Therefore he says, "You have descended.
21.translation: If, indeed, you have Indra, then he argues that it is Indra. This means that it is enough for Purandara to become Indra. If, indeed, the god himself becomes Indra, how can I become? Therefore he says, "You have descended.

22.word_for_word: सुरभिर् आत्मनः पयसा अभ्यषिञ्चत् । — Surabhi anointed herself with her own milk.; इन्द्रश् चाकाश-गङ्गाया जलैर् अभ्यषिञ्चत् ॥२२॥ — Indra also sprinkled him with the waters of the Ganges in the sky.; देवा-मातृभिर् अदित्यादिभिः, देवैर् मातृभिश् चेति वा । — or by the mothers of the gods, such as Aditi, or by the mothers of the gods.; गाः पशून्, गां स्वर्गं वा इन्द्रत्वेन विन्दतीति कृत्वा गोविन्द इत्य् अभ्यधात्, नाम कृतवान् इत्य् अर्थः ॥२३.२४॥ — Having made the cows the cattle, the cow or heaven as Indra, he called him Govinda, meaning that he gave him a name.
22.translation: Surabhi anointed herself with her own milk. Indra also sprinkled him with the waters of the Ganges in the sky. or by the mothers of the gods, such as Aditi, or by the mothers of the gods. Having made the cows the cattle, the cow or heaven as Indra, he called him Govinda, meaning that he gave him a name.

25.word_for_word: देव-निकायेषु केतव इव दर्शनीया मुख्या इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that they are the main ones to be seen in the bodies of the gods, like the stars.; गावो गां पृथ्वीं पयोभिर् द्रुताम् आर्द्राम् अनयन् । — The cows quickly moistened the earth with their milk.; अकुर्वन्न् इत्य् अर्थः ॥२५॥ — They did not, that is, they did not.
25.translation: This means that they are the main ones to be seen in the bodies of the gods, like the stars. The cows quickly moistened the earth with their milk. They did not, that is, they did not.

26.word_for_word: नाना-रसौघाः क्षीरादि-वाहिन्यः । — They are streams of various juices and carriers of milk and other substances.; अकृष्त-पच्याः कर्षणं विनैव पक्वा ओषधयो व्रीह्य्-आदय आसन् । — Uncultivated and ripe herbs such as oats were ripe without cultivation.; यद् वा, अकृष्ट-पच्या ओषधयो येषु ते गिरय उन्मणीन् गर्भ-गतान् मणीन् उत् उद्गतान् बहिः प्रकटान् अबिभ्रद् अबिभरुः ॥२६.२८॥ — That is, the mountains in which the herbs, which were not plowed and digested, carried the gems which had fallen from the womb and which had emerged and were exposed outside.
26.translation: They are streams of various juices and carriers of milk and other substances. Uncultivated and ripe herbs such as oats were ripe without cultivation. That is, the mountains in which the herbs, which were not plowed and digested, carried the gems which had fallen from the womb and which had emerged and were exposed outside.
